latest.title: De Estudante para Estudante: Por que você deve começar na AWS hoje?
latest.description: Este artigo apresenta o AWS Builder Center como uma ferramenta essencial de desenvolvimento pessoal e técnico para estudantes de Engenharia, conectando a teoria da sala de aula à prática na nuvem. Através de um guia de boas-vindas, compartilho minha visão como aluna do IBMEC sobre como o acesso gratuito a recursos globais da AWS pode ser o grande diferencial na jornada de quem está começando em tecnologia.

latest.title: How AWS Free Tier Can Replace Most Paid Courses for Beginners
latest.description: This blog explores how the Amazon Web Services Free Tier can be a powerful, hands-on alternative to traditional paid courses for beginners. It focuses on learning by building real projects, avoiding common pitfalls, and using practical roadmaps to gain real-world cloud skills.

latest.title: AWS Bedrock AgentCore: The Infrastructure Layer Every Agent Platform Needs First
latest.description: The infrastructure layer is the foundation everything else runs on. This post covers the three AWS Bedrock AgentCore components every enterprise agent deployment needs before anything else: Runtime for managed agent hosting, Identity for integrating your existing IdP, and Gateway for a governed integration layer between agents and the tools they call. For architects making the decisions that are expensive to change later.

latest.title: Before You Ship AI Agents at Enterprise Scale, Get the Foundations Right
latest.description: Building an AI agent is easy. Building an enterprise AI agent platform is not. This post makes the strategic case for getting foundations right before use cases: what enterprise readiness actually requires, how AWS Bedrock AgentCore addresses each concern as a suite of managed primitives, and why the sequencing of this investment matters as much as the investment itself. For technology leaders evaluating where to start with AI agents at scale.

latest.title: From Infrastructure as Code to Infrastructure as Intent: How GenAI is reshaping the way we build
latest.description: The way we build cloud infrastructure is changing. For years, IaC gave us repeatability, governance, and speed through templating. However, in the era of GenAI, we must adopt a new paradigm: describing what you want rather than defining it. This post explores that shift - from IaC templates to Infrastructure as Intent (IaI). But LLMs are probabilistic, this probability poses governance risks. To solve this, we can use Kiro Steering to encode organizational standards and OPA to validate AI output.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: Global Impact AI Navigator

Designed for innovators in emerging markets, it democratizes access to the strategic guidance that usually requires expensive consultants or elite networks.

Ingressar no ecossistema da AWS como Student Builder Leader mudou minha pesrpectiva. Como graduando em Segurança da Informação, meu foco era 'como proteger'; o AWS Builder Center me ensina a 'construir com segurança'.
